title: How do we find the city with the largest area?
description: This is a research task, so the video shows a method and gives no city facts. The child decides what counts as a city, looks up the areas in square kilometres from reliable sources, writes them in one list in the same unit, checks them, and picks the largest number.
teaching_notes: One idea: to compare areas, use one meaning of the city and one unit for every number. Watch for students who compare a city in square kilometres with another in square metres.

source: Find the city with the largest area in India and in the world
video_script.why: The child has met the square kilometre as the unit for large areas and now uses it to compare real cities from sources they look up.
video_script.substitution: The book question has no numbers because the child looks them up, so the video gives no city names or areas.
video_script.anchor: an empty table with a column of city names and a column of areas in square kilometres
video_script.payoff_line: Pick the largest number in your list, and that city has the largest area.

final_answer.value: an open task: compare official areas in km² and pick the largest number in your list
final_answer.spoken: an open task, compare official areas in square kilometres and pick the largest number in your list

maths_rules: the city means the area run by the city's own government, used the same way for every city
areas come from an atlas, a census report or a government website, in km2
all areas are written in the same unit; 1 km2 = 1000000 m2
the answers depend on how a city's boundary is defined
no city names or areas are given in the video
video_script.design: An empty two-column table stays on the board. Each step adds a line under it, and no city names or numbers are written, because the child looks them up. The India list and the world list are two copies of the same table.
open_questions: This is an open research task. The video gives the method only and invents no city facts, so the final answer is the method for picking the largest number.
